description.value: Steveston Outdoor Pool is a City of Richmond–operated seasonal outdoor swimming facility located in the historic Steveston fishing village neighbourhood. Sitting near the Steveston waterfront, it is a classic community pool well-positioned for cyclists riding the popular Richmond dyke trail network. The pool operates as a summer destination, making it a natural cooling-off stop on a warm-weather tour of the Fraser River delta.
